Dynowarz - The Destruction of Spondylus.name: Dynowarz: Destruction of Spondylus
Dynowarz - The Destruction of Spondylus.summary: Something was terribly wrong in the distant man-made Spondylus star system. One by one, the planets' central life-support computers had been infected with a life-threatening virus while the planets' surfaces had been overrun with computerized dinosaurs known as Robosaurs. Under attack in his laboratory on Alpha Planet, Professor Proteus, mastermind of the Spondylus System and founder of the Robosaur project, suddenly realized that this deadly sabotage could only be the work of his former partner, the deranged Dr. Brainius.

Godzilla - Monster of Monsters!.name: Godzilla: Monster of Monsters
Godzilla - Monster of Monsters!.summary: The invaders from Planet X attack earth as part of their plan to conquer the entire universe, using a legion of space monsters. The earth sends Godzilla, the strongest monster on the earth, and Mothra, to defend itself. Godzilla advances through 8 battle stages to defeat a legion of space monsters controlled by Planet X. For the sake of the future of the earth, Godzilla's fierce battle now begin...

Goonies II, The - Fratelli Saigo no Chou.name: The Goonies II
Goonies II, The - Fratelli Saigo no Chou.summary: The Goonies II features two modes of play: platform and first-person. Most of the game is played as the former as the player works through a non-linear map. The player moves Mikey to new areas of the map by ladders or doors that may act as warp zones. Several different types of zones are found in the game, each with distinct enemies, graphics and music.

Great Gatsby, The.name: The Great Gatsby
Great Gatsby, The.summary: The Great Gatsby is a platform game inspired by the 1925 novel of the same name by F. Scott Fitzgerald. Loosely borrowing characters and locations from the original story, players guide Nick Carraway through four main levels. The game is jokingly said to be a localized, unreleased port of the Japanese NES game Doki Doki Toshokan: Gatsby no Monogatari and the developers even made up fake advertisements, credits and a cartridge photo. It is however an entirely original browser game created to resemble a NES platformer from the 8-bit era.

Indivisible.name: Indivisible
Indivisible.summary: An actual NES ROM demaking Lab Zero's Indivisible

Lord of King, The.name: Astyanax
Lord of King, The.summary:
It is a 2D action platform game focused on hack and slash and spell casting. The game consists of six linear levels of which each has two sub-levels meaning the game consists of 12 level in total. After every level there is a cut-scene pushing the story forward.

There are three weapons - an axe, a spear and a big sword. An axe is a basic weapon the hero holds at the beginning of the game. The player can upgrade the axe using a power-up which has the shape of a small axe. The spear is the second stage of the weapon upgrade system and the big sword is the final stage. The big sword is the most powerful melee weapon in the game.

The player can cast three magic spells which using is limited by the magic meter. The first is "Bind", which stops the time altogether with the enemies in the level. The second is "Blast", which casts fire balls destroying all enemies visible on the screen at the time of the casting. The third is "Bolt", which has the form of a lightning strike and acts similarly to "Blast".

Solar Wars.name: Solar Wars
Solar Wars.summary: Solar Wars is a tank combat game like Scorched Earth on the PC, Scorched Tanks on the Amiga, or Gorillas from QBasic. The game is two-player and pits you against a foe throughout our solar system. You can fight against a friend using two controllers, or the same controller, on ten different worlds, each with its own gravity, atmosphere, and climate.

Uncharted Waters.name: Uncharted Waters
Uncharted Waters.summary: Uncharted Waters is a 16th century trade and combat simulation RPG for the Nintendo NES allowing players to take on the role of a seafaring trader.
